description: Search for Zendesk macros by their title. Use when you need to find macros in your Zendesk account by searching for keywords in their titles. Macros are pre-defined responses or actions that can be applied to tickets to automate repetitive tasks. This action supports filtering by access, active status, category, and group, as well as sorting results.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk macros.

access.description: Filter macros by access. Options: 'personal' (user's own macros), 'agents' (all personal macros for account's agents, admin only), 'shared' (macros shared with the user), 'account' (account-level macros).
access.human_parameter_description: Choose which type of macros to search for: your own personal macros, macros shared by agents, shared macros, or account-level macros.
access.title: Access

active.description: Filter by active macros if true or inactive macros if false. When not specified, returns both active and inactive macros.
active.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to show only active macros, only inactive ones, or both. Useful for finding macros that are currently available.
active.title: Active

category.human_parameter_description: Enter a category ID to show only macros in that specific category.
category.title: Category

group_id.human_parameter_description: Enter a group ID to show only macros assigned to that group.
group_id.title: Group Id

include.description: A sideload to include in the response. See Zendesk docs for available sideloads (e.g., 'usage_7d' returns usage statistics for the last 7 days).
include.human_parameter_description: Add extra information to the results, such as how many times each macro was used in a certain time period.
include.title: Include

only_viewable.description: If true, returns only macros that can be applied to tickets. If false (default), returns all macros the current user can manage.
only_viewable.human_parameter_description: When enabled, shows only macros you can actually apply to tickets. When disabled, shows all macros you can manage.
only_viewable.title: Only Viewable

query.description: Query string used to find macros with matching titles. Case-insensitive partial match on macro titles.
query.human_parameter_description: Enter keywords to search for macros by their title. The search matches partial titles case-insensitively.
query.title: Query

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Options: 'alphabetical' (sorts A-Z), 'created_at' (by creation date), 'updated_at' (by last modification), 'position' (by dashboard position). Defaults to alphabetical.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Choose how to order the search results: alphabetically by title, by when they were created, by when they were last updated, or by their position.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sorts, 'desc' for created_at and updated_at sorts.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose whether results appear in ascending order (A-Z, oldest first) or descending order (Z-A, newest first).
sort_order.title: Sort Order
